top_rope_harvest_source_projection.precondition: No rope above the harvested segment; lower segments have the same identity/facing and independently sturdy wall support.
top_rope_harvest_source_projection.limit: Source/native callback reasoning, not an actual harvest or a claim all free-hanging chains fail to cascade.

minimum_height_source_projection.precondition: Server survival interaction on a rope at the level minimum, same rope held; target one block lower, upper rope satisfies its survival check.
minimum_height_source_projection.limit: Source/native boundary derivation only; no placed world, packet, inventory or survival reachability test.

positive_scope: All six current ropes have explicit ladder overrides and actual native registrations. Scaffold design choice, 1..255 support-search bound, ladder exclusion for design3 and empty-world update hooks exist.
No wall-supported lower-rope removal callback replaces the original top harvest action; do not infer free-hanging native neighbor-update chains never fall.
Native noCollission disables default entity collision while the outline/getShape and ladder API remain independent. Cover collision fallback returns the original shape without a block-entity host.

Current normal placement uses modern world limits; retain negative-height support. The minimum boundary finding concerns the unchecked first downward target and ignored failed placement, not a recommendation to restore y>=0.
limits: Four support roles, eight corner point comparisons, eight design declarations and one lower-boundary case are source projections only, not geometry queries, player motion, block updates or a real inventory/harvest test.
Two native cached artifacts/ten entries and five read-only javap class outputs only; no target class initialization, compile, Gradle, test, game, build or push.

Rope/scaffold physical property registrations, flammability, exact support opacity, chunk-load boundaries, permissions, texture/rendered dimensions, crafting, cover lifecycle and independent saved-world restart remain incomplete.
Four production files retain all code/literal positions and directives; one stale Neo registry description is corrected. User material tables and all gameplay stay unchanged.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash original/current/platform/native entry and raw javap evidence, verify snapshots and full code/literal positions/comments/directives, trace rope native registration/collision and harvest consumers, scaffold boxes and cover-host gating, and both native world-height placement wrappers. No target class, geometry API, player, inventory, handler or game execution.
